data-the-application-description-gains-o.text: Data: the application description gains one question.

invariants.text: configuration-and-request-are-disjoint: no output is both named as configuration and decoded as a request.
an output at a key address is never configuration: discovery's key-address check comes first, so such a holder keeps its skip.
the skipped list and the pending list never contain an output named as configuration.

unchanged.text: The reasons a holder is skipped, the receipt fields (folded, skipped, left, reconciled) and the request and pending records.
